name: end_of_turn
instruction: The caller has paused on a phone call with an agent. Is it the agent's turn now? The caller is done once they have asked their question, made their request, or answered what the agent asked (even in a different form than asked: a name, a date, a code read out), in a complete sentence. They are not done if the last words leave the sentence hanging, if they are partway through reading out a number, or if they have only greeted, given their name or set the scene without yet saying what they want. How the transcript ends is given below: a question mark almost always means they are done; no sentence end usually means more is coming.

options.describe: finished: they asked a question, made a request, answered the agent, or confirmed or declined, in a complete sentence. Reply now
probably finished: a complete answer or statement that might still get one more sentence

not finished: the sentence is left hanging (it stops on 'and', 'the', 'with', 'for', a repeated word, or a noun that needs more), a number is only partly read out, or they have only greeted, given their name or the background, without yet saying what they want. They will continue
telling something long, a story or an explanation: a pause is them thinking. They will continue
